<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../lib/paypal_sdk.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../lib/orders_store.php';
use PaypalServerSdkLib\Models\Builders\{OrderRequestBuilder, PurchaseUnitRequestBuilder, AmountWithBreakdownBuilder, AmountBreakdownBuilder, ItemBuilder, MoneyBuilder};
header('Content-Type: application/json');
$cart = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
$total = 0.0; $items = [];
foreach ($cart as $sku => $qty) {
    if (!isset($PRODUCTS[$sku])) continue;
    $p = $PRODUCTS[$sku];
    $items[] = ItemBuilder::init($p['name'], MoneyBuilder::init(SHOP_CURRENCY, $p['price'])->build(), (string)$qty)->build();
    $total += $p['price'] * (int)$qty;
}
if ($total <= 0) { http_response_code(400); echo json_encode(['error' => 'empty cart']); exit; }
$r = $orders->createOrder(['body' => OrderRequestBuilder::init('CAPTURE', [
  PurchaseUnitRequestBuilder::init(AmountWithBreakdownBuilder::init(SHOP_CURRENCY, number_format($total, 2, '.', ''))->breakdown(AmountBreakdownBuilder::init()->itemTotal(MoneyBuilder::init(SHOP_CURRENCY, number_format($total, 2, '.', ''))->build())->build())->build())
  ->items($items)->build()])->build(), 'prefer' => 'return=representation']);
$orderId = $r->getResult()->getId();
orders_save(['token' => $orderId, 'amount' => number_format($total, 2, '.', ''), 'status' => 'CREATED', 'created' => date('c')]);
echo json_encode(['id' => $orderId]);

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../lib/paypal_sdk.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../lib/orders_store.php';
header('Content-Type: application/json');
$in = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
$orderId = $in['orderId'] ?? '';
$order = orders_get($orderId);
if (!$order) { http_response_code(404); echo json_encode(['error' => 'unknown order']); exit; }
if ($order['status'] === 'PAID') { echo json_encode(['ok' => true, 'transactionId' => $order['transaction_id'], 'amount' => $order['amount']]); exit; }
try {
    $res = $orders->captureOrder(['id' => $orderId, 'prefer' => 'return=representation']);
    $capture = $res->getResult()->getPurchaseUnits()[0]->getPayments()->getCaptures()[0];
    $order['status'] = 'PAID';
    $order['transaction_id'] = $capture->getId();
    orders_save($order);
    echo json_encode(['ok' => true, 'transactionId' => $order['transaction_id'], 'amount' => $order['amount']]);
} catch (Exception $e) { http_response_code(502); echo json_encode(['error' => 'capture failed']); }
changes: Added replay guard (check status before capture)

if (!$order || $order['status'] !== 'PAID') { http_response_code(400); echo json_encode(['error' => 'order is not paid']); exit; }
try {
    $res = $payments->refundCapturedPayment(['captureId' => $order['transaction_id']]);
    $order['status'] = 'REFUNDED'; $order['refund_id'] = $res->getResult()->getId();
    orders_save($order);
    echo json_encode(['ok' => true, 'refundId' => $order['refund_id']]);
} catch (Exception $e) { http_response_code(502); echo json_encode(['error' => 'refund failed']); }

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/lib/paypal_sdk.php';
$webhookId = getenv('PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID');
if (!$webhookId) { http_response_code(500); exit; }
$headers = getallheaders();
$payload = file_get_contents('php://input');
$res = $client->getNotificationsController()->verifyWebhookSignature(['body' => ['auth_algo' => $headers['PAYPAL-AUTH-ALGO'], 'cert_url' => $headers['PAYPAL-CERT-URL'], 'transmission_id' => $headers['PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-ID'], 'transmission_sig' => $headers['PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-SIG'], 'transmission_time' => $headers['PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-TIME'], 'webhook_id' => $webhookId, 'webhook_event' => json_decode($payload, true)]]);
if ($res->getResult()->getVerificationStatus() === 'SUCCESS') {
    $event = json_decode($payload, true);
    if ($event['event_type'] === 'PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED') {
        file_put_contents(__DIR__ . '/data/webhook.log', $payload . "\n", FILE_APPEND);
    }
}
http_response_code(200);
